name: keynote-pipeline
description: A self-contained HTML product keynote + scroll-driven site + teaser, with a Gemini/ElevenLabs asset-generation pipeline. Fork it, replace the deck's slides, ship your own.
comment:deps: Pinned EXACT, not ranged. These are the versions that rendered the reference build, and two of
them are load-bearing beyond their API surface. playwright decides which Chromium runs, and
export-video.mjs's --audio-shift -38ms is a constant measured against that build's
AudioContext.baseLatency (0.021333) — the script asserts it and hard-exits on a 20% drift, so a
silent minor bump breaks video export outright. @google/genai floats a generative API: a caret
here means an unattended install changes what your prompts render into. Bump deliberately, and
